title: Daniel Loncar TV - Videos
description:
-This YouTube Channel will be about travels, sports activities , animals, nature and planet protection and sometimes about random experiences...

-I am a nature lover and adventure seeker on the soul searching journey. 

-This videos are one of the ways I m expressing myself in order to motivate and inspire others for positive change, to open their mind, question everything and see the world with THEIR OWN EYES.
